main_text.p: Francisci Cardinalis Barberini amicitiam per literas coluit; laetatus est Cardinalis, talem, habere eorum, quae tunc Parisiis agebantur, exploratorem ac monitorem, qui sedis Apostolicae nuncium tunc ibi commorantem saepius inviseret. Contigit autem circa illud tempus, famosum Patris Celloti Jesuitae Librum de Hierar-chia & Hierarchis Parisiis in fronte testi-monio; de hoc statim Cardinali Barbe-rino scripsit Morinus {z} urgens promptam ac severam sedis Apostolicae in illud opus Animadversionem; monet Cardinalem, aliis opus esse remediis, quam illis, quibus in Patris Boni Libros animadversum fuerit, & haec cum frustra adversus Jesuitas, quibus Cardinalis Richelius favebat, ab Episcopis Galliae aut a Sorbona sperarentur, non aliunde pro ea tempestate expectari posse, quam a Pontifice Maximo. Iterum Morinus per aliam Epistolam, quam ipsi nuncio Romam redeunti dederat, Barberino significat, Celloti librum ab Episcopis Me-dun-

page.notes: The reference mark in the text is printed as a parenthesised z, "(z)"; it is given here as {z}. Word spacing in the first line is tight in the scan ("FrancisciCardinalisBarberini"); spaces were restored between the words. Printed forms left as they are: "Richelius", "animadversum", "Barbe-rino" (initial letter partly worn), "expectari". Line ends with "Me-" and the catchword "dun-" continue the same word.
